## Change

Describe the problem, the affected project, and the resulting behavior.
Link a related issue if one exists.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and their results. For UI changes, include the browser,
device/viewport, manual checks, and screenshots where useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused on one project or repository concern.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass (`npm --prefix Switchback run verify` for Switchback).
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression tests or manual verification.
- [ ] Affected documentation and player-facing changelog entries are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, dependency folders, or generated build output are included.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have source and license information, if applicable.
